approach: Fix the display and instruction in the producer brief only. briefs.rs gets a producer-only "Report criteria_check" section: each criterion as a bare verbatim line, plus an instruction for one entry per criterion, in order, with evidence, including satisfied ones. The change producer.md gets one pointer sentence. The shared producer.md criteria_check line is shortened, never lengthened. The CriterionCheckOutput docs and the run.rs send-back text use the same "copy the line" wording. In run.rs, extract the inline send-back text into a named function `send_back_text(brief, &unmet) -> String`, used by the loop and unit-tested. Add two full-run tests on the existing run_pin_tests.rs harness (named as a supporting test file of run.rs) for send-back count. Matching in unmet_criteria stays unchanged. Before rates are reported as unmeasured, because the producer sandbox cannot read records/, unless the brief supplies them. The note gives the exact repeatable counting procedure.

decisions.choice: Add a verbatim copyable criteria list and an explicit one-entry-per-criterion instruction to the producer brief only; keep the numbered list for cross-reference.
decisions.reason: Copying removes the retyping that makes wording drift. The brief is not token-budgeted like the shared prompt, and planner briefs stay unchanged.

rejected.why: The shared prompt is at 1276/1300 tokens, and without a copyable form the model still retypes from memory.
Field docs are short, are read less than the brief, and cannot supply the exact text.
It could accept a different criterion as met and hides the drift instead of fixing it.

decisions.choice: Shorten, never lengthen, the criteria_check line in the shared producer.md, and drop its 'without its number or kind tag' wording.
decisions.reason: It is a listed deliverable, but the budget forbids growth, and the old wording must not sit beside the copy-the-line instruction.

rejected.why: The wording conflicts with the copy-the-line instruction.

decisions.choice: Extract the send-back text (run.rs:1442-1454) into `send_back_text(brief, &unmet) -> String`. Its new sentence replaces '(without its number or kind tag)' with: 'report every acceptance criterion in criteria_check, copying each line from the brief's criteria_check section as its text, with its status and your evidence'. The briefs.rs section and the outputs.rs docs use the same phrase 'copy the line'.
decisions.reason: A named function lets a unit test show the send-back names the omitted criterion's exact text. It also fixes the stale wording in one place and keeps the three texts consistent.

rejected.option: Keep the text inline and only 'align' wording
rejected.why: Nothing could be unit-tested and the old tag wording could survive.

rejected.option: Send-back lists every criterion with its status
rejected.why: Out of scope, and it does not reduce first-report misses.

decisions.choice: Show criterion 5 with a unit test of send_back_text in run.rs plus two full-run tests in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs (athena_with plus a producer Tweak, counting producer invocations as the test near line 722 does). The first report omits one criterion: two producer invocations, and the second brief contains the omitted text. The second report is complete: one invocation. Do not re-add the unmet_criteria tests that already exist there.
decisions.reason: That file is the test module for run.rs (declared in lib.rs:84 as `mod run_pin_tests`) and the only place the full-run harness exists. Existing tests already cover unmet_criteria, so only the new behaviors are added.

rejected.option: Unit tests only in a new run.rs module
rejected.why: They would repeat existing unmet_criteria tests and could not show 'sent back once'.

decisions.reason: Matching is not the root cause. The drift comes from retyping, which the verbatim list removes.

rejected.why: It risks accepting a different criterion as met.

files.purpose: Add the producer-only criteria_check section with bare verbatim lines and the instruction, plus tests.
Add one short sentence pointing to the brief's criteria_check section.
Shorten the criteria_check line; remove the 'without its number or kind tag' wording.
Reword the CriterionCheckOutput docs to 'copy the line from the brief's criteria_check section'.
Extract send_back_text(brief, &unmet), replace the tag wording with the copy-the-line sentence, and unit-test it. Matching unchanged.

Add the two full-run send-back tests (omitted criterion: two invocations; complete report: one). This is the test module for run.rs. It is not on the brief's deliverable list, so the verifier is told it is a test-only addition.
Record the cause, the alternatives, the unmeasured before rates with the counting procedure, and the after status.

steps: Read the existing run_pin_tests.rs tests near lines 690-768 and the briefs.rs producer_brief and reading_sections code.
Edit briefs.rs: add the producer-only criteria_check section (bare verbatim lines, then the instruction) and its unit tests.
Add the pointer sentence to the change producer.md, shorten the shared producer.md line, and reword the outputs.rs docs with the same 'copy the line' phrase.
In run.rs, extract send_back_text(brief, &unmet), use it in the loop, replace the tag wording and add its unit test. Add the two full-run tests to run_pin_tests.rs.
Try to read the six job records. Expect them to be unreadable and mark them so. Write the decisions.md note with the repeatable counting procedure, and the CHANGELOG.md entry.
Run cargo test, the budgets test, cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets.

risks.risk: The shared producer.md budget (1276/1300) is exceeded.
risks.mitigation: Only shorten that file and run the budgets test.

risks.risk: The brief change breaks planner brief tests.
risks.mitigation: Add the section in producer_brief only and keep the numbered list.
Label all six unmeasured with sample size 0, name the records, and give the counting procedure. Invent nothing.

risks.risk: Extracting send_back_text changes the existing message and breaks pin tests.
risks.mitigation: Change only the one sentence. Run the existing run_pin_tests and update only assertions that pin the old tag wording.

risks.risk: A model can still skip a criterion.
risks.mitigation: The note says the fix is measured only on later jobs and gives the procedure.

demonstrations.observes: The note names display (numbered, tagged list that cannot be copied), the shared prompt line and the 'without its number or kind tag' field doc as contributors. It cites run.rs unmet_criteria and criterion_key, the criteria rendering in briefs.rs, both producer prompts and outputs.rs CriterionCheckOutput. It lists prompt only, schema only and tolerant matching as alternatives.

demonstrations.method: Read the rates section of the diff.
demonstrations.observes: The note gives a before entry for each of kb23, c2h3, 7qht, 0qcy, c4w4 and skh5. Each is marked unmeasured (the producer sandbox cannot read records/, briefs.rs:224-225) with sample size 0 of 6 readable, and all six records are named as unreadable, unless the brief supplied them. The note gives the repeatable procedure: per job, count producer invocation records under records/<job>/invocations/ whose detail contains 'self-check failed', where more than one producer invocation means a send-back. The note says there are no jobs since the change, so the after rate is not yet measurable.

demonstrations.method: New briefs.rs unit test builds a producer brief from a reading with several criteria. It asserts each criterion text appears as its own bare line, with no number or kind tag, in order. It asserts the brief instructs one criteria_check entry per criterion, in order, with evidence, including already-satisfied ones. It asserts the planner brief lacks the section.
demonstrations.fails_without: The old brief has only '1. [kind] text' lines and no instruction. The bare-line assertion and the one-entry-per-criterion assertion would both fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the budgets test and inspect the prompt diffs.
demonstrations.observes: The test passes. The shared producer.md diff is a net shortening. The change verifier.md has no diff. New instructions are only in the change producer.md and the rendered brief.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the shared producer.md or the change verifier.md grew past its token budget, the budgets test would fail.

demonstrations.method: Three tests. (a) A unit test in run.rs: send_back_text with an unmet list contains the omitted criterion's exact text and the copy-the-line sentence, and not 'without its number'. (b) A full-run test in run_pin_tests.rs where the first producer report omits one criterion: two producer invocations, and the second brief contains the omitted text. (c) A full-run test where the report has a met entry for every criterion: one producer invocation.
demonstrations.observes: All three pass: the complete report is not sent back, and the incomplete one is sent back once with the exact text named.
demonstrations.fails_without: If a missing entry were ignored, (b) would see one invocation. If a complete report were sent back, (c) would see two. If the send-back dropped the criterion text, (a) and (b) would fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks in turn.
demonstrations.observes: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check each exit 0, with no warnings and no formatting diff, including the new tests.
demonstrations.fails_without: A failing new test, a clippy warning or unformatted code makes the matching command fail.

open_questions: The records of the six jobs are not readable from the producer sandbox, so the before rates are expected to be unmeasured unless the brief supplies them.
Whether any test covers brief token size beyond the prompt-file budgets test; I have not read it.
The exact producer Tweak API in run_pin_tests.rs for reporting a chosen criteria_check; the producer must read the tests near lines 690-768.
